scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The quaternary length-three Golay-pair count of 128 is known in 2002 literature and is not claimed as original.
The all-order statement applies only to unit-modulus six consecutive nonzero taps at N>=12, with all translations and exactly two modulations.
Proof is analytic. Finite exact and numerical checks supplement, not replace, universal proof.
Novelty comparison is bounded by indexed literature and material inspected; possible unindexed equivalent results remain a priority risk.
An independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Antipodal rigidity and exact phase classification for six-tap two-channel cyclic Gabor tight frames
